title: Turkish Wagyu Dumpling Kebabs
description: A delicious kebab dish combining the rich flavors of Turkish spices with the tenderness of Wagyu beef, served with a side of pan-seared dumplings.

ingredients.name: Turkish-Style Spice Mix
ingredients.notes: Available at most grocery stores or online

ingredients.name: Dumpling Wrappers
ingredients.notes: Found in most Asian grocery stores

ingredients.name: Wagyu Beef Broth
ingredients.notes: Available at most grocery stores or online

instructions: 2. In a small bowl, mix together Turkish-Style Spice Mix, salt, and pepper.
3. Add Wagyu beef to the spice mix and toss to coat evenly.
4. Thread Wagyu beef cubes onto skewers.
5. Brush kebabs with Nice Grass Fed Butter.
6. Grill kebabs for 5-7 minutes per side, or until Wagyu beef reaches 130°F.
7. Meanwhile, heat Wagyu Beef Broth in a large skillet over medium heat.
8. Add Dumpling Wrappers to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until wrappers are lightly browned.
9. Serve kebabs with pan-seared dumplings and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
